Theme

Latin word

status

status, statūs m.

noun, fourth declension

posture, position of the body; fixed, appointed, regular (of times and days); score; state, condition (of affairs); condition, state, situation; condition, standing; position, rank, condition in life

In this lexicon

  • position

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Off. 1.128: status incessus, sessiō accubitiō; Plaut. Mil. 206: crēbrō commūtat statūs

  • regular

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 44.37: lūnae dēfectiō statīs temporibus fit (Lewis & Short, s.v. sistō); Liv. 42.32.2: statō locō statīsque diēbus

  • score

    also used · modern · Traupman 44, 50; Andresian p. 20

  • situation

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 1.8.1: dē tōtō statū rērum commūnium

  • state

    the recommended word · classical · Cic. Verr. 1.12: restituī in antīquum statum (Lewis & Short); Cic. Fam. 3.11.4: reī pūblicae statum (Lewis & Short); Traupman 295

  • state

    avoid · classical · Traupman 180: Ūnītī Statūs, the United States; Traupman 206

  • status

    also used · classical · Cic. Fam. 4.4.1: ex prīstinō statū nostrō; Cic. Leg. 1.23 (Lewis & Short); Traupman 25, 385
